connection.offlineDetail: You are offline. Nothing you enter here will be lost, but it will not reach the clinic record until the connection returns.

device.enrolledBody: Every request this tablet makes is signed with a key that has never left it. Values entered here are attributed to it.
device.forgetHint: Only if an administrator asks. The tablet will need a new code to write anything.
device.notEnrolledBody: This tablet can sign a person in, but it cannot record clinical values until an administrator enrols it. Ask for a code from the device screen of the admin console; it works for fifteen minutes.
device.codeHint: Ten characters, as shown on the administrator's screen. Case and dashes do not matter.
device.refused: The code was not accepted. It may have expired or been used; ask for a new one.
device.offline: The clinic server cannot be reached. Nothing was changed.
device.unexpected: Enrolment did not complete. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the administrator.
device.done: Enrolled. This tablet can now record values.

login.subtitle: DTHC clinic staff only.
login.offlineTitle: The clinic server cannot be reached
login.offlineBody: Check the network connection and try again. Nothing was sent.
login.unexpected: Sign-in did not complete. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the administrator.

placeholder.title: {screen} is not built yet
placeholder.body: This screen exists so the shell can be navigated and reviewed. It lands at {checkpoint}.

queue.subtitle: Patients waiting at your station, in the order they will be called.
queue.emptyDetail: When somebody is sent to your station they will appear here.
queue.waitingCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody waiting} one {# patient waiting} other {# patients waiting}}

realtime.liveDetail: This screen is receiving updates as they happen.
realtime.reconnectingDetail: The live connection dropped and is being re-established.
realtime.offlineDetail: This screen is not receiving updates and may be behind. Anything you save is still recorded.

secondFactor.codeHint: The six digits your app shows now.
secondFactor.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved when you set up the authenticator. It works once.
secondFactor.loginBody: Your password was accepted. Now the code from your authenticator app.

registration.resumeTitle: You have a registration in progress
registration.resumeBody: {name} was partly registered. Carry on, or start again.
registration.birthHint: The year alone is enough if that is all they know.
registration.future: That date has not happened yet.
registration.implausible: That would make them over 130. Check the year.
registration.nationalIDHelp: Hashed and sealed before it is stored.
registration.backgroundNote: For research. Skip anything not asked.
registration.consentNote: A patient cannot be registered without a recorded consent.

role.tapToSwitch: Tap to act as another role you hold
role.chooseTitle: Which role are you working as?
role.noPasswordNeeded: No password needed. The switch is recorded.
role.switchFailed: That role could not be confirmed. Nothing has changed.

anthropometry.blocked: Check the highlighted value before saving.
anthropometry.notThisStation: This station’s capture screen is not built yet.
anthropometry.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.
anthropometry.warnLow: Below {limit} {unit}, which is unusually low for this measurement.
anthropometry.warnHigh: Above {limit} {unit}, which is unusually high for this measurement.
anthropometry.warnRose: More than {limit} {unit} above the last recorded value.
anthropometry.warnFell: More than {limit} {unit} below the last recorded value.

note.no_reference_for_sex: No published growth reference covers this patient’s recorded sex.
note.too_old_for_a_growth_reference: Growth percentiles apply up to 20 years of age.
note.nothing_measured_yet: No height, weight or BMI has been recorded yet.

vitals.halfABloodPressure: A blood pressure needs both numbers.
vitals.belowNormal: Below {limit} {unit} — outside the usual range for this patient.
vitals.aboveNormal: Above {limit} {unit} — outside the usual range for this patient.
vitals.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.

alerts.title: Act on this now
alerts.belowLimit: Below {limit}, which is the critical low.
alerts.aboveLimit: Above {limit}, which is the critical high.
alerts.sentDetail: They have been told. Stay with the patient until somebody comes.
alerts.goAndFind: No screen was listening. Go and tell a doctor in person, now — do not wait for the system.
alerts.seenAndGoing: I have read this — going to find a doctor

examination.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.
examination.notTestedReason: Why the foot could not be tested
examination.scoreOutOfRange: The symptom score runs from 0 to 13.
examination.interrupted: The {feet} foot is only part tested. Go back and finish it — nine sites is not a monofilament test.

prompt.ulcerHistory: This patient has had a foot ulcer or an amputation. Record the ulcer status of both feet today.
prompt.sensationLost: The {side} foot had lost protective sensation when it was last tested. Repeat the monofilament.
prompt.retinopathySevere: The {side} eye was graded severe or proliferative. Look again and grade it today.
prompt.retinopathyDue: This patient's eye screening is due, or has never been done.

terminology.title: Coded diagnosis
terminology.unreachable: The coded catalogue cannot be reached
terminology.freeText: You may still record the diagnosis in your own words; it can be coded later.
terminology.nothingFound: Nothing in the catalogue matches what you typed.
terminology.noFavourites: This clinic has not ranked any diagnoses in this catalogue yet.
terminology.atCap: Showing the first {n}. Type more to narrow the list.

reason.favourite: A diagnosis this clinic makes often
reason.wordStart: A word starts with what you typed
reason.similar: Close to what you typed — check the spelling

history.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.
history.lifestyleHint: Recorded there and shown here so nobody asks twice. Two answers to one question cannot both be the current one.
history.carriedHint: Ask the patient about each one. Nothing here counts as true today until somebody says so.
history.nothingCarried: Nothing has been recorded for this patient before.
history.allConfirmed: Everything has been confirmed this visit.
history.oneAtATime: One press, one item. There is no button that confirms the list.

why.neverConfirmed: Nobody has confirmed this since it was recorded
why.notThisVisit: Last confirmed at an earlier visit

history.resolveHint: A clinical fact worth keeping. It stays in the record.
history.removeHint: This was never true. Say why — the reason is the point of removing it.
history.removeReason: Why this should not have been recorded
history.uncodedHint: The catalogue has nothing for this. It is kept in words and counted, so the catalogue can be corrected.
history.unknownKind: Recorded under a kind this tablet does not know

field.duration: How long it has been going on

problem.partialCoding: A coding is a system, a version and a code. Choose from the catalogue again, or record this in words.
problem.wrongCatalogue: That code is from another catalogue. This kind is coded in its own.
problem.nothingSaid: Choose a code, or write what the patient said.
problem.needsRelation: A family history is about a relative. Say which one.
problem.noRelation: This is about the patient, not about a relative.
problem.needsDuration: A complaint says how long it has been going on.
problem.notADuration: A duration is a whole number of days.
problem.noSeverity: This kind of history carries no severity.
problem.noOnset: This kind of history carries no start date.
problem.onsetPartial: A start date and how exact it is travel together.
problem.noDose: Only a medicine carries a dose.

trouble.refused: The server would not record this
trouble.unreachable: The clinic server cannot be reached
trouble.failed: The clinic server could not answer

history.troubleHint: Nothing was recorded. What the patient said is still only in this room — try again before they leave.

status.unknown: An answer this tablet does not know

meaning.NONE_RECORDED: The allergy question has not been put to this patient. That is not the same as having none.
meaning.ALLERGIES_RECORDED: One or more allergies are recorded below, worst first.
meaning.NO_KNOWN_ALLERGY: Somebody asked, and the patient knows of no allergies.
meaning.UNABLE_TO_ASSESS: Somebody asked and the answer could not be got. It does not mean there are none.
meaning.unknown: The server gave an answer this tablet is too old to read. Treat the allergy status as unknown.

empty.NONE_RECORDED: Nothing is recorded because nobody has asked. Do not read this as “no allergies”.
empty.ALLERGIES_RECORDED: The status says allergies are on file, but none came back. Do not read this as “no allergies” — ask again.
empty.NO_KNOWN_ALLERGY: Nothing to record: the patient was asked and knows of no allergies.
empty.UNABLE_TO_ASSESS: Nothing is recorded because the answer could not be got, not because there is nothing.
empty.unknown: Nothing came back, and this tablet cannot read the status. Treat it as unknown.

gate.blocked: This patient cannot be sent to the next station until the allergy question is answered.
gate.open: The allergy question has been answered. This patient may be sent on.
gate.hint: The checkpoint is in the clinic’s database, not in this app. Nothing here can go round it.

allergies.withdrawClosesGate: Taking this back closes the checkpoint again unless an allergy is recorded.

answer.title: Answer the allergy question
answer.hint: Three ways to answer it, and there is no fourth. None of them can be skipped.

allergies.inYourName: Whichever you choose is recorded in your name, and a prescriber will rely on it.

assertHint.NO_KNOWN_ALLERGY: Only after asking. This says, in your name, that the patient knows of no allergies.
assertHint.UNABLE_TO_ASSESS: Somebody looked and could not get an answer. It is not a statement that there are no allergies.

allergies.reasonLabel: Why the answer could not be got
allergies.reasonPlaceholder: Patient is drowsy and no attendant present.
allergies.nothingMissing: Everything this allergy needs has been answered.
allergies.uncodedHint: The catalogue will not have everything. What the patient called it is worth far more here than a blank — it is kept, marked uncoded, and shown on every screen.
allergies.withdrawHint: Nothing is deleted. The entry stays with your reason beside it, because the next clinician needs to know somebody once believed it.
allergies.changesHint: Withdrawn entries included. Somebody believed it and somebody else disagreed, and both halves are worth reading.
allergies.noChanges: Nothing has been said about this patient’s allergies yet.

problem.partialCoding: A coding is a system, a version and a code. Choose from the catalogue again, or record this in words.
problem.nothingSaid: Choose the substance from the catalogue, or write what the patient called it.
problem.unknownReaction: That reaction is not one this clinic records. Choose one from the list.
problem.needsCertainty: Say whether this is suspected or confirmed.
problem.needsReason: Say why the answer could not be got. Without it this is a silent gap wearing a label.
problem.reasonRefused: “No known allergies” takes no reason. It is the answer itself.
problem.needsWithdrawalReason: Say why this should not stand. The reason is the point of taking it back.

trouble.refused: The server would not record this
trouble.unreachable: The clinic server cannot be reached
trouble.failed: The clinic server could not answer

allergies.troubleHint: Nothing was recorded, so the checkpoint is still shut and this patient cannot be sent on. Try again — there is no way round it.
